\newcommand{\TableTwoBody}{%
Prior and noise variances; their sum (2) and a range for the noise variance (1 to 1.5) are known; smallest mean-square error requested & Optimal gain lies between $1/4$ and $1/2$ & Question about the noise variance & Batch conditioning: gains 0.25 and 0.50 \checkmark \\
As above; a mean-square error below 0.65 is requested & None: gain $1/4$ meets it for every admissible split & Release (Kalman), no question needed & Errors 0.375 and 0.625 at the two extreme splits, affine in between \checkmark \\
Initial-error bound; an ultimate limit is requested & None: initial-error terms vanish in the limit & Release (observer), omission reported as irrelevant & Worst case after 400 steps equal for zero and large initial error \checkmark \\
Initial covariance; a steady-state (limit) statement is requested & None: the steady-state gain and its limit do not depend on it & Release (Kalman), omission reported as irrelevant & Riccati iteration from two initial covariances: same gain \checkmark \\
Distribution of the noises & Same estimate; only the linear-estimator claim holds & Release (Kalman), omission reported as irrelevant & Monte Carlo variance matches for Gaussian and uniform noise \checkmark \\
Hard bound on the measurement error & The guaranteed limit depends on it & Question about the hard noise bound & Design certified for one bound violates the limit for a larger admissible one \checkmark \\
Hard noise bound; an RMS value is supplied instead & No hard bound follows from an RMS value & Question about the hard noise bound & Noise with fixed RMS and arbitrarily large magnitude \checkmark \\
Noise bound known only as a range & Requirement is met on part of the range only & Question about the hard noise bound (with the decisive threshold) & Worst case meets the limit at the threshold, not above it \checkmark \\
Sample period stated as a range & Model, gains and certificate depend on the period & Question about the exact period & Wrong period: velocity error 2 rad/s on error-free data \checkmark \\
A deadline is added later & The initial error, irrelevant before, now matters & Question about the initial-error bound (with the decisive threshold) & Earlier design violates the deadline for an admissible initial error \checkmark \\
Evidence that the motion stays in the stated range & The mismatch bound holds only inside the range & Question about the evidence for the range & Mismatch outside the range exceeds the bound used inside \checkmark \\
Whether a noise value is a spectral density or a per-step covariance & The two readings differ by a factor of order $T$ & Question about the meaning of the value & Quadrature: the two readings give different discrete covariances \checkmark \\
Discrete model with a different stated period & A discrete model cannot be re-sampled & Invalid input & Supplied matrix is not the transition for the stated period \checkmark \\
Data recorded every 2 ms, request states 1 ms & Gains and certificate hold for one period & Release withdrawn (timing conflict) & Release withdrawn for these data; the same records with 1 ms timestamps are processed \checkmark \\
None: a transient cap below the later tolerance & At $t = 0$ one reading carries no speed information & No estimator can meet it & Admissible initial speeds span $\pm 2$ rad/s, above the cap \checkmark \\
None: a total and a tighter additive disturbance bound & The smaller bound applies & Release (observer), no question needed & Independent worst case with the additive bound meets the limit \checkmark \\}
